review_scope: Independent read-only code and failed-run evidence review of the exact two-file IME-readiness repair; this report is the only file written by this reviewer.

failed_run.failure: Timed out at 8-second wait bound: native Cancel dismisses

observed_evidence: The Latin landscape Y-field click at 16:01:18.422 was followed by an IME show request at 18.558 and onShown at 19.217; the final native Cancel click at 19.309 occurred after that onShown event.
There is no IME hide request between the final Latin Y-field tap and Cancel or during the ensuing 8-second dismissal wait. Cleanup starts at 16:01:27.494.
Gboard logs fullscreen mode and a 640x158 keyboard body on the 640x320 landscape display.
The successful Kana control logs IME shown at 16:01:58.721, native Back hide at 59.902, hidden at 59.938, Cancel click at 16:02:00.112 and window callback removal at 00.253.
All seven locale methods log four show requests and four onShown events each. Each passing method has four native Back hide requests; failed Latin has three.
Production Cancel remains the native setNegativeButton(..., null) path; only Apply overrides its click listener. Ainu Latin does not mount the vertical shell.
inferences_and_unknowns: High-confidence mechanism: hideIme sampled hidden insets before the pending show completed, so the test proceeded to a Cancel coordinate while the landscape IME was shown.
The actual receiver of the failed native touch is not logged. IME occlusion is strongly supported, but a Cancel ACTION_DOWN/UP or keyboard key receipt is not captured.
The assertion is the individual 8-second wait failure, not exhaustion of the shared 45-second interaction deadline.
The evidence does not justify relabeling the failure as a flake or changing production Cancel handling.

patch_review.finding: Waits for field focus, window focus and visible IME after the real field tap and before Ctrl+A/Delete/text injection; closes the observed pending-show hole before the unchanged native Back hide.
Fails closed unless the window is focused and IME is hidden immediately before capturing tap coordinates; does not retry clicks or replace the native listener.
The new readiness wait remains inside the existing diagnostic catch, which reports field geometry, focus and IME visibility.
Source-contract checks bind the show barrier ordering, hidden tap guard and native Back hide, and forbid programmatic show/hide/click shortcuts. These checks do not simulate Android IME timing.
